cover.text: Rep. Josh Gottheimer wants the NSA to test AI models before release.

slides.headline: Two bipartisan AI bills unveiled Friday
slides.body: On September 18, Rep. Josh Gottheimer (NJ-5) unveiled two bipartisan AI security bills at Fairleigh Dickinson University in Teaneck.

slides.headline: No mandatory AI safety checks today

slides.quote: Right now, there are no mandatory requirements for pre-deployment testing of frontier AI models.
slides.highlight: no mandatory requirements for pre-deployment testing of frontier AI models

slides.headline: The NSA would get 30 days to vet a model
The FIREWALL Act would extend that ban
slides.body: DeepSeek is already blocked from federal devices. Gottheimer named Kimi K3 and Qwen as Chinese open-weight models the bill would also keep off federal systems.

slides.headline: He's also pressing the White House on AI cyberattacks
A floor vote isn't scheduled
slides.body: Gottheimer said Republican leadership has refused to directly bring the bills to the floor for a vote, and sent Congress home. He is urging the Speaker to reconvene.
slides.highlight: refused to directly bring the bills to the floor
